what_happened: Style/layout 2 (same built-in microwave over a wall oven as s3, s8, s11; base stopped to the right of the microwave, oblique view). Stage 0: lemon grasped at 96, released into the wooden bowl at 233, stage 0 at 235. Stage 1: bowl grasped at 269, released inside at 564, stage 1 at 575 (340 steps). The lemon rolls in the bowl and touches the fingers during the release (476-504) but stays in. Stage 2: the gripper got to the free edge of the open door at ~722 and stayed in contact almost continuously until 1240 with the arm barely moving (left view 760-1160 is nearly static). The door crept from closedness 0.02 to 0.21 by 768, then oscillated 0.22-0.34 for ~400 steps (pushes that slip back), reached 0.40 at 1216 and 0.51 at 1296. After the last contacts (1268-1291) the arm withdrew to the right and hovered in front of the keypad (1304-1400), as if the door were done. Door ended half open (0.51).
causal_chain: bowl placed 564 -> gripper at the door edge from 722 -> 570 steps of pushing move the door only to 0.51 closedness (needs >= 0.995) -> arm leaves the door at ~1291 and moves toward the keypad -> door half open at timeout
self_recovery: the push resumed several times (rises at 976-1040, 1184-1216, 1280-1296), each gaining a little; it never re-grasped the edge or moved the base.
uncertain_about: Why the push was ineffective: the arm looks fully stretched toward the door from a base that did not move (my reading), but the packet has no base pose or contact force. The bowl did not visibly block the door.
